literal_meaning: কথা (talk) + বার্তা (news/talk); word-by-word: talks or conversations
example_sentences_in_bangla: আজকাল তার সাথে কথাবার্তা কম হয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: There is conversation going on between the two.
These days, conversation with him has decreased.
note: This is a common Bengali compound word (yugma shabda) rather than a highly figurative idiom.
